description.value: Firehouse Subs is a Canadian fast-food sandwich chain serving hot, toasted subs with a focus on hearty, flavourful fillings. The brand is also known for its Public Safety Foundation of Canada, which has donated over $6.3 million in equipment grants to first responders across the country. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient stop on South Fraser Way for a filling meal with takeout and online ordering available.
